name: snaglet
description: Snaglet — a desktop app where you and a team of AI agents share one workspace, kept in a PostgreSQL database on your own machine.

scripts.dev: pnpm dev:setup && cross-env SNAGLET_ENV=dev concurrently -n shared,db,server,desktop-ui "pnpm --filter @snaglet/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @snaglet/db dev" "pnpm dev:server" "pnpm dev:desktop-ui"
scripts.dev:server: pnpm dev:setup && cross-env SNAGLET_ENV=dev pnpm --filter @snaglet/server dev
scripts.dev:desktop: pnpm dev:setup && cross-env SNAGLET_ENV=dev pnpm --filter @snaglet/desktop-shell dev
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @snaglet/theme typecheck && pnpm --filter @snaglet/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @snaglet/shared build && pnpm --filter @snaglet/db typecheck && pnpm --filter @snaglet/sdk typecheck && pnpm --filter @snaglet/server typecheck
scripts.typecheck:all: pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter @snaglet/ui typecheck && pnpm --filter @snaglet/desktop-ui typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p build/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:eslint && pnpm lint:realtime && pnpm lint:docs
scripts.test:unit: cross-env NODE_ENV=test node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --selectProjects unit:server unit:shared
scripts.test:coverage: cross-env NODE_ENV=test SNAGLET_COVERAGE=1 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --selectProjects unit:server unit:shared
scripts.test:integration: cross-env NODE_ENV=test node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --selectProjects integration:server integration:db
scripts.test:package-exports: pnpm --filter @snaglet/shared build && pnpm --filter @snaglet/db build && pnpm --filter @snaglet/sdk build && node scripts/verify-package-exports.mjs
scripts.test:build-profiles: tsx --test tests/build/build-profiles.test.ts tests/build/native-helpers.test.ts tests/build/packaged-app-smoke.test.ts tests/build/desktop-build-sdk.test.ts tests/build/rust-toolchain.test.ts tests/build/desktop-bundle-no-console.test.ts tests/build/no-colocated-jest-tests.test.ts tests/build/preview-scratch.test.ts tests/build/ensure-dev-env.test.ts tests/build/release-contracts.test.ts tests/build/docs-gate.test.ts tests/build/db-chain.test.ts tests/build/install-app.test.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck:all && pnpm test:package-exports && pnpm test:tool-registry && pnpm test:ui && pnpm test
